💼
¿Qué harás?

La forma de desarrollar software está cambiando. Herramientas como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code y otros asistentes de IA permiten acelerar enormemente el desarrollo, pero seguimos necesitando buenos ingenieros capaces de diseñar la solución, tomar decisiones técnicas, integrar sistemas y garantizar que el código generado sea mantenible, seguro y esté preparado para producción.

Ahí entras tú.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend con .NET y Azure, acostumbrada a construir APIs, microservicios e integraciones cloud-native.

Trabajarás en soluciones donde Azure es una parte fundamental de la arquitectura, utilizando servicios como AKS, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault o Application Insights, entre otros.

Y queremos que la IA forme parte de tu forma habitual de desarrollar: desde generar y refactorizar código hasta crear tests, documentación, revisar implementaciones o acelerar la resolución de problemas.

✅
Lo que necesitamos de ti

Imprescindible tener al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con .NET, con especial foco en:

· Desarrollo .NET / C#: experiencia sólida con .NET moderno, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Dependency Injection, configuración, logging y gestión de errores.

· Diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST, incluyendo definición de contratos, versionado, autenticación/autorización, validación y documentación con OpenAPI/Swagger.

· Arquitecturas de microservicios: diseño de servicios desacoplados, comunicación síncrona y asíncrona, resiliencia, observabilidad y gestión de errores.

· Azure Functions: desarrollo de funciones HTTP, event-driven y background processing, incluyendo triggers y bindings.

· Integración en Azure: experiencia trabajando con servicios como Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid y Storage Queues/Blob Storage para construir arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e integración entre sistemas.

· Azure Key Vault y gestión segura de secretos, certificados y configuración sensible.

· Conocimiento de Managed Identities, Entra ID y OAuth2/OIDC para autenticación entre aplicaciones y servicios Azure.

· Experiencia trabajando con SQL Server / Azure SQL y acceso a datos desde .NET, idealmente utilizando Entity Framework Core.

· Conocimientos de Docker y containerización de aplicaciones .NET.

· Experiencia trabajando con Git y procesos de CI/CD, entendiendo cómo una aplicación pasa desde el código hasta los diferentes entornos.

· Experiencia real utilizando asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA, como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code o herramientas similares, no sólo para autocompletar código, sino como parte habitual del ciclo de desarrollo.

Esperamos que seas capaz de utilizar IA para generar, revisar, refactorizar, documentar y testear código, manteniendo siempre criterio técnico sobre lo que genera.

🔍
Nos suma mucho si además:

· Has trabajado con arquitecturas event-driven y patrones como Pub/Sub, queues, topics o asynchronous processing.

· Experiencia desplegando o desarrollando aplicaciones que se ejecutan sobre Kubernetes, trabajando con containers, configuración, secrets, health checks, scaling y troubleshooting básico.

· Conoces patrones de diseño de microservicios como API Gateway, Circuit Breaker, Retry, Outbox, Saga o CQRS.

· Tienes experiencia con Azure Container Apps además de AKS.

· Has trabajado con Application Insights, Azure Monitor y Log Analytics para observabilidad y troubleshooting.

· Responsabilidad con tu trabajo y compromiso con el equipo.

· Curiosidad por cómo la IA generativa y los agentes están transformando el ciclo de desarrollo de software.

inua: tendrás acceso a cursos top en tecnología e innovación.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer, R&D
jobs.description:
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.

Unique problems to solve: a good fix in the morning can be live in production by the evening, and it will be serving real partner traffic.

Nuitée is hiring Senior Product Engineers to join Connect, the domain at the heart of our platform. Connect is where hotel supply from hundreds of suppliers becomes one clean API that partners build on: how we connect to suppliers, price and serve inventory at scale, and make fragmented travel data usable in real time.

You'll work across the full lifecycle, building new capabilities and scaling the systems partners rely on every day. You'll go from idea to production without detailed specs, and you'll be accountable for whether what you ship creates real value.

The problem is hard: latency, correctness, cost and supplier limits all pull in different directions, and the product decisions can't be separated from the technical ones.

What makes it interesting for you:

You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape and teams make their own product decisions. A good idea in the morning can be in production by the evening, and many iterations ship in days rather than months.
You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there, including when to say no.
You get genuinely hard engineering problems. Caching, multi-supplier pricing, data pipelines, and routing under strict latency budgets all interact in real time.
You'll shape how we build. We got to roughly €1B in booking value with a lean team. Now we're building the next phase of the platform as we push toward €10B, and you'll help set the engineering and product standards.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.

The kind of problems you’ll work on:

How do we take fragmented, inconsistent data from hundreds of suppliers and serve it reliably through a clean API?
How do we cache and deliver a pricing matrix covering 100k+ hotels so partners can use it in real time?
How do we answer multi-supplier rate requests within strict latency budgets, route to the best suppliers, and protect supplier QPS and system stability under load?
How do we harmonize data across suppliers (room mapping, for example), including with LLM-assisted approaches?

You’ll work on problems where the product, technical approach, and best path forward are still being figured out.
The role is backend-heavy and product-driven. You should be comfortable going from idea to design, implementation, and real usage, without needing detailed specs.
A good way to think of it is: you build the first version that proves something works.

This role fits someone who:

Is a senior and hands-on backend engineer, ideally with experience in Go (but we’re also interested in people from C#, Java, C++ or similar backgrounds who want to pick up Go).
Has built products or major features from scratch.
Thinks in terms of outcomes and user value, not just implementation.
Is comfortable working without clear specs or structure.
Can make pragmatic tradeoffs and move fast.
Has experience with APIs, data-heavy systems, or distributed environments.
Takes ownership beyond their scope and pushes things forward.

Nuitée is fast-moving, low on process, and high on ownership. This suits people who are comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and responsibility. It is less suited to people who prefer structured environments and clearly defined scope from day one.

If that resonates, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2 to 3 weeks

Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)

Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution

Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da organização, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia e objetivos de negócio.

Experiência em ambientes colaborativos, com equipas multidisciplinares e/ou globais.

new_jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken

Ministerie van Defensie

Organisatieomschrijving

Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.

Bij het ministerie van Defensie werken ongeveer 79 duizend mensen direct en indirect aan vrede en veiligheid. Het ministerie bestaat uit het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT), de Bestuursstaf (het departement), de Koninklijke Marine, de Koninklijke Landmacht, de Koninklijke Luchtmacht, de Koninklijke Marechaussee, het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO).

Defensie is een van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland en vertoont overeenkomsten met een groot bedrijf. De operationele commando's (zee-, land- en luchtstrijdkrachten), de Marechaussee, het DOSCO en de COMMIT lijken op werkmaatschappijen.

Commando Materieel en IT

Afdelingsomschrijving

Standplaats: Bernhardkazerne te Amersfoort

Onder de vlag van JIVC, de IT organisatie van defensie, als onderdeel van het Commando Materieel en IT (COMMIT), ga je werken bij de afdeling Landgebonden IT/sectie Systeemontwikkeling en Integratie (SO&I).

COMMIT zet zich in om collega’s in binnen- en buitenland het best mogelijke te bieden: het beste materieel, de beste voorraden en de beste ICT. Zo kunnen zij hun werk zo krachtig en effectief mogelijk doen.

De afdeling Landgebonden IT draagt op basis van diepgaande kennis van operationele gebruikers- en instandhoudingsprocessen, bij aan de vertaling van eisen en wensen naar concrete specificaties, hetzij t.b.v. Een eigen software-ontwikkeltraject dan wel t.b.v. Een extern aan te besteden ontwikkelopdracht. Landgebonden IT voert daarnaast het systeemmanagement over alle in stand te houden systemen, trainers en simulatoren. Landgebonden IT levert tevens (ook on site) support op de door de afdeling geleverde systemen en levert technische assistentie bij de implementatie en vervanging van deze systemen.

De sectie Systeemontwikkeling en Integratie is verantwoordelijk voor het integreren van extern verworven en/of intern ontwikkelde systemen en het zelf ontwikkelen en onderhouden van systemen.

Visie

Het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT) ondersteunt de transitie naar een informatie gestuurde en technologisch hoogwaardige krijgsmacht met het beste materieel en de beste IT. Ons COMMITment is groot om de cruciale rol te versterken als strategisch partner van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten, van de operationele onderdelen en van internationale partners. COMMIT vergroot de impact van de ondersteuning door een integrale en innovatieve aanpak van materieel- en IT-projecten, (wapen)systeemmanagement en ketenlogistiek.

Wij investeren in de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de flexibiliteit en diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. De belangrijkste capaciteiten van COMMIT zijn de kennis en ervaring van ons personeel. Om de krijgsmacht sneller te voorzien van materieel en IT zetten wij naast technologische innovatie in op proces- en sociale innovatie op het gebied van projectvoering, inkoop en afstoting van defensiematerieel en personele en logistieke ondersteuning.

Het uitvoeren van innovatieve projecten vraagt om meer samenwerking met het bedrijfsleven, kennisinstituten en andere overheidsorganisaties en maatschappelijke instanties. Onder de vlag van C-COMMIT als National Armaments Director (NAD) ontwikkelen en versterken wij ook de internationale samenwerking op het gebied van materieel en IT (NAVO, EU, multinationaal en bilateraal).

Missie

COMMIT levert de krijgsmacht het beste materieel en de beste IT.

Extra

COMMIT is van iedereen en voor iedereen, we zijn ervan overtuigd dat we met een diverse en inclusieve organisatie onze taak, verbinding maken tussen willen en kunnen, het beste kunnen uitvoeren wanneer ons personeel een afspiegeling is van de maatschappij. Wij nodigen je daarom graag uit om te solliciteren op deze functie!

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI  (Netherlands)
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

The base wage range for this position based in The Netherlands is targeted at 143,000 - 184,000 EUR per year.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 
For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks . 
Diversity At Justworks
Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. new_jobs.description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. 

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Job Description

The role

We are looking for a Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer to join our Data Science & AI team as a consultant. This is a client-facing role first: most of your time is spent on client engagements, designing and building Azure infrastructure and platform solutions, advising on cloud strategy, and representing Sia's technical delivery capability directly to the client. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. If you want client exposure plus a genuine way to build AI skills on top of your infrastructure expertise, this is a team where that combination is real.

What you will do

Work directly with client teams and stakeholders as a consultant, explaining technical trade-offs and architecture decisions in plain language.
Design and implement Azure infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and identity components (Azure AD/Entra ID, VNets, App Services, AKS).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Manage and optimize Microsoft 365 and Azure governance, including security baselines, cost management, and compliance controls.
Build demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry to support business development and potential client work.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across hybrid and cloud-native environments.
Advise clients on cloud migration strategy, landing zone design, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Collaborate with client IT teams, architects, and Sia consultants to deliver technical roadmaps and implementation plans.
Document architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.
Depending on seniority, mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal capability building within the Azure and AI practice.

Qualifications

What you bring

Comfortable working directly with clients as a consultant, and able to explain technical trade-offs in plain language.
Willing and able to travel for client work (mostly within the Benelux).
3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in a production environment.
Strong knowledge of Azure core services: compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD tooling.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID/Azure AD.
Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or similar.
Interest in or experience with Azure AI Foundry or building AI demos/proofs of concept is a strong plus.
A relevant Microsoft certification (AZ-104, AZ-305, or AZ-400) is a plus.
Fluent in Dutch and English.
For senior candidates: experience leading architecture decisions on client-facing engagements and mentoring other engineers.

What do we offer?

Competitive salary package, including annual salary increase, bonuses, and NS Business Card.
Tailored training and development opportunities to position you as an expert in your field.
Flexible working arrangements (office, home, client sites) and international project exposure.
Collaborative global environment fostering professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Additional Information

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide a work permit for this position.

About the Role

We believe customer interactions are evolving toward AI agents that actively support personalized financial choices. These agents depend on high-quality enterprise data and knowledge to provide accurate, grounded, and reliable support. Preparing this information and systematically evaluating the quality of AI assistants are essential to creating valuable customer-service solutions.
That is why we are looking for an AI Engineer to strengthen our Conversational AI teams. You will focus on preparing enterprise data and knowledge for advanced AI assistants and applying evaluation frameworks across single-turn, multi-turn, simulated, and agentic scenarios. In this role, you will help ensure that our assistants provide accurate, grounded, and reliable support to advisors.
Key Responsibilities

Collaborate within a scrum team to prepare, structure, enrich, and validate enterprise data for AI knowledge bases and AI Chatbots.
Build and maintain data pipelines in Databricks to process structured and unstructured data for AI knowledge bases.
Apply evaluation frameworks to test advanced chatbots across single-turn, multi-turn, simulation-based, and agentic scenarios.
Prepare, clean, transform, and enrich source data to improve the quality and reliability of information used by AI assistants.
Create and maintain evaluation datasets covering realistic conversations, complex cases, edge cases, and multi-step workflows.
Implement automated testing, monitoring, and quality gates for changes to data, prompts, models, retrieval, and orchestration.
Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, particularly Azure Bicep and CI/CD pipelines.
Analyse evaluation results and translate findings into improvements across knowledge, retrieval, prompts, tools, and application logic.Support communication to end users and customers.
Prioritise requests based on customer value and business impact.
Identify opportunities to improve services, applications and internal processes.
Ensure digital products contribute to customer value, commercial performance and strategic objectives.

Candidate Requirements

Mandatory Requirements

A strong engineering and data-quality mindset, with an affinity for Agile development.
A proactive, hands-on approach to solving complex AI-quality and cloud-engineering challenges.
Strong critical thinking, ownership, and accountability for production-ready solutions.
Excellent communication skills and a customer-centric attitude.
A relevant HBO or university degree and fluency in English.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience with data engineering and automated testing.
Hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks, DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code, preferably Bicep.
Experience building data pipelines and preparing structured and unstructured enterprise data for AI knowledge bases and RAG applications.
Experience applying evaluation methods to advanced chatbots, including multi-turn, simulated, and agentic interactions.
Familiarity with Context Engineering, Agentic AI, Function Calling, retrieval strategies, and tool use.

new_jobs.description:
Wat we samen gaan bereiken:

Dit ga je doen:

Als Senior Test Automation Engineer bij Astek Nederland kom je niet om simpelweg scripts te runnen. Onze klanten (van de energiesector tot de semi-overheid) zitten vaak midden in uitdagende transities: van legacy naar cloud-native, of van handmatig testen naar full-blown CI/CD pipelines. Jij bent de specialist die de klant helpt navigeren. Of de stack nu vraagt om Cypress, Playwright, Tosca of Robot Framework: jij doorgrondt de architectuur en adviseert over de beste aanpak. Jij bent degene die developers meeneemt in het verhaal dat kwaliteit een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid is. Kortom: jij brengt de senioriteit die nodig is om testautomatisering strategisch te laten landen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

Strategisch Advies: Je kijkt verder dan de bug. Je analyseert de behoeften van de klant en adviseert over de teststrategie en tooling die optimaal aansluit bij hun specifieke architectuur.
Engineeren: Je bouwt en optimaliseert robuuste, schaalbare frameworks die standhouden in een continu veranderende omgeving.
CI/CD Integratie: Je zorgt dat geautomatiseerde tests een integraal en betrouwbaar onderdeel worden van de deployment pipeline (bijv. Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
Lead & Coaching: In consultancy-omgevingen ben jij de deskundige. Je coacht collega's en neemt een natuurlijke voortrekkersrol binnen Agile-teams om de kwaliteitsstandaard te verhogen.

Wat jou onderscheidt:

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in testautomatisering en bent gewend om te acteren binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen.
Tooling is voor jou een middel, geen doel. Je hebt diepgaande kennis van (meerdere) frameworks zoals Cypress, Playwright, Tosca, Selenium of Robot Framework.
Je hebt ruime ervaring met API-testen en begrijpt hoe microservices en moderne architecturen in elkaar steken.
Je bent communicatief sterk: je kunt technische keuzes onderbouwen richting zowel developers als management.
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Waarom Astek voor jou de juiste stap is:

Bij ons heb je de regie over je eigen loopbaan, zowel in je projecten als in je beloning. Kies je beloningsmodel: Ga je voor het Profit-model (een unieke combinatie van zekerheid en een zeer hoog variabel inkomen voor de ondernemende professional) of liever voor het Solid-model (een stabiel, hoog marktconform salaris met uitgebreide extra's)?
Onbeperkt Groeien: Wij geloven niet in vaste budgetten. Heb jij een specifieke certificering of training nodig om de beste te blijven in je vak? Wij regelen het. Zonder limiet.
Brabantse Gezelligheid: We zijn een hecht team met korte lijnen. Naast de inhoud maken we tijd voor fun: van jaarlijkse citytrips (Marbella!) tot regiouitjes en familiedagen.

Dit bieden wij

Een vast contract vanaf dag één
Een competitief salarispakket afgestemd op jouw ervaring -> wil je alvast een beeld hebben? Neem dan een kijkje naar onze salarismeter
28 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen
Hybride werken, je werkt 1 tot 2 dagen op kantoor bij de klant

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

The Import Export organization is a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales the infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within an established senior engineering team and partner with business stakeholders to develop the products, features, and services that drive and evolve RelativityOne.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Create architecture and non-functional designs for Import/Export services that meet SLO and SLA targets.
Decompose complex problems into resilient, cloud-native solutions and deliver milestones with measurable outcomes.
Advise and mentor team members on code quality, technical debt management, and engineering best practices.
Own production systems by leading on-call activities, root cause analyses, and proactive issue resolution efforts that reduce MTTR.
Drive operational excellence by leveraging observability data to prioritize work, automate alerts, and expose trustworthy metrics.
Partner with Product to shape the roadmap through clear trade-off discussions and data-backed decisions.
Optimize CI/CD practices by designing automation that keeps deployments predictable and compliant.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience delivering C#/.NET services or similar technologies with measurable reliability or performance improvements.
Experience architecting distributed SaaS systems and translating business requirements into resilient technical designs.
Proven production ownership experience, including leading on-call rotations, conducting root cause analyses, and using telemetry to reduce MTTR and incident volume.
Experience building and operating cloud-native solutions (Azure experience is a plus; any major cloud platform is acceptable).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, automated testing, and deployment governance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Fluency in English with strong technical communication skills.

Preferred

Experience leading microservice initiatives for high-volume, event-driven workloads.
Experience scaling ingestion platforms, data pipelines, or ETL workflows with measurable outcomes.
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting agile planning and cross-team collaboration.

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

Working Environment and Location

This position is 100% onsite in Tralee, Ireland.

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.

Purpose and Scope

Responsible for the administration, support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QC laboratory computerized systems and automated laboratory equipment. The role ensures reliable, compliant, and secure operation of laboratory systems, supporting laboratory operations, data integrity requirements, system integrations, and regulatory compliance within a GMP environment.
Provide technical ownership and lifecycle management of QC laboratory systems and automated laboratory equipment.
Support administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of laboratory platforms including Empower, LabX, LIMS, and instrument control software.
Manage system integrations between laboratory instruments, enterprise applications, Active Directory, and site IT/OT infrastructure.
Coordinate system patching, upgrades, backup and recovery activities in line with site procedures and vendor recommendations.
Support qualification, validation, change control, periodic review, and audit readiness activities for laboratory computerized systems.
Develop and maintain system documentation, administration procedures, support guides, and asset inventories.

Third-level qualification in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Automation, or a related discipline, with experience supporting computerized laboratory systems in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical/biotech environment.
Experience with laboratory applications such as Empower, LabX, LIMS, CDS, and ELN, including laboratory instrument connectivity, system integrations, and IT/OT networking.
Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, user management, security, and system administration skills, with proven troubleshooting capability across software, hardware, network, and instrument communication issues.

new_jobs.description:
Senior fullstackutvikler – Java eller .NET

Hva om du kunne være med på å bygge konsulentselskapet du selv ønsker å jobbe i?
CLEF er et nytt IT-konsulenthus der erfarne folk får påvirke oppdragene de tar, fagmiljøet de blir en del av og hvordan selskapet utvikles. Vi er åpne om lønn og vilkår fra første samtale. Nå ser vi etter senior fullstackutviklere til CLEF Consulting.

Dette vil du jobbe med

Du utvikler digitale tjenester hos kunder, fra brukergrensesnitt til backend, API-er og integrasjoner. Oppdragene vil variere, men fellesnevneren er at du får bruke erfaringen din til å bygge løsninger som er gode å bruke, videreutvikle og drifte.

Du samarbeider med utviklere, designere, arkitekter og fagfolk hos kunden. Du bidrar i tekniske valg, testing og kodegjennomgang, og deler gjerne kunnskap med andre i teamet. Mellom oppdrag kan du også bruke tid på faglig utvikling, tilbudsarbeid eller CLEFs egne verktøy.

Vi tror du passer hos oss hvis du

har solid erfaring med Java/Kotlin og Spring Boot eller C# og .NET/ASP.NET Core

har jobbet med frontend, gjerne React og TypeScript

kan utvikle API-er og integrasjoner og har god forståelse for SQL og relasjonsdatabaser
er opptatt av kodekvalitet, testing, sikkerhet og løsninger som tåler endring
samarbeider godt med kunder og kolleger og kan kommunisere godt på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig

Vi ser helst etter deg med minst fem års relevant erfaring, men vurderer også andre profiler som passer godt. Erfaring med Azure eller andre skyplattformer, CI/CD, containere eller større systemmiljøer er en fordel.

Dette får du hos CLEF

En åpen lønnsmodell:
Du får 65 % av fakturerbar årsinntekt, inkludert feriepengeavsetning. Pensjon kommer i tillegg. Prøv ulike timepriser og timetall i lønnskalkulatoren vår.
Trygghet mellom oppdrag:
Du er fast ansatt og har en garantilønn på 4G uavhengig av fakturering.
Innflytelse på oppdragene:
Vi vurderer aktuelle oppdrag sammen.
Mulighet for medeierskap:
Ansatte kan tjene opp eierandeler over tid. Vi går gjennom modellen og vilkårene i rekrutteringsprosessen.

De fleste oppdragene er i Oslo-området og krever noe tilstedeværelse hos kunden kombinert med mulighet for hjemmekontor. Omfanget avklares før du sier ja til et oppdrag.

Nysgjerrig?
Les mer på clef.no/karriere, eller send oss noen linjer om hva du kan og hvilke oppdrag du ønsker deg. Vi rekrutterer løpende.

new_jobs.title: Full-stack Developer – Digital Marketing and CRM
new_jobs.description:
You could call it a Full-stack Developer role - but we’re really looking for someone who enables seamless, personalized customer journeys through smart technology.

The CRM and Marketing Solutions unit at If P&C Insurance is advancing its capabilities in data driven marketing and supporting a digital first strategy. To create customer-centric solutions in this area we utilize many data sources and turn them into event-driven personalized solutions with high business impact.

We want to offer our customers personalized journeys driven by important life events. You will have a key role in making this happen.

About The Role

As a Full-stack Developer, you will be developing APIs, integrations and applications to enable us to communicate with leads and customers in a safe and secure way and ensure that If can reach out in any channel through our new Bloomreach Engagement CDP platform and transform data into personalized customer journeys. You’ll join an easy-going Nordic team of developers who make this happen and have fun while doing it.

You’ll develop B2C and B2B integrations solutions in .Net and C# in Azure Cloud and connect them to our omni-channel CRM touchpoints (email, SMS, web, CX, app, chat and marketing channels) and first party data sources so we can communicate with leads, partners and customers. This includes development and integration to CRM data sources both in Azure, on-premise and to partners via APIs, reliable and asynchronous messaging, and various other channels of data communication. You will practice Agile and DevOps in your day-to-day life.

We offer

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

About The Team

We’re a Nordic team of highly motivated developers who are passionate about serving customers with timely, personalized communications to help them live a worry-free life and insure what is most dear to them. We work closely with business stakeholders to make this happen and value common Agile DevOps principles with CI/CD so we can continuously deploy value to clients.

We promote continuous tech nurturing, certifications and learning including hackathons both within our team and together with our partners at Microsoft, Bloomreach and Google. We love experimentation and constantly follow new technology to create better solutions.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about solution development in Azure
and have a solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming
using .NET
and C#
.

You Bring

Strong experience with .NET, C#, and Object-Oriented Programming
Experience developing solutions in Azure Cloud
Proficiency in REST APIs, microservices, and message-based architectures
Solid knowledge of Azure data storage (SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Storage)
Awareness of Information security and protecting our customers’ integrity (GDPR)
Bonus: Experience with React for UI development

You Also Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
Excellent communication skills in English
Proven experience in application and software development

Meillä pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä, jolla vaikutetaan suomalaisen yhteiskunnan turvallisuuteen. Olemme keskeinen toimija turvallisen digitaalisen yhteiskunnan kehittämisessä. Tarjoamme puolustus- ja turvallisuussektorin asiakkaille moderneja ja korkean turvallisuuden vaatimusten mukaisia palveluita. Varmistamme ja vahvistamme laaja-alaisella osaamisellamme viranomaisten kriittisten toimintojen sujuvuutta ja jatkuvuutta sekä tietoturvaa muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä. Palvelemme laajasti myös puolustukseen ja turvallisuuteen liittyviä teollisuusasiakkaita.

Tutustu asiakastarinoihimme: Digi- ja väestötietovirasto, Tampereen kaupunki & Verohallinto.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset

Rakentamaan moderneilla teknologioilla ratkaisuja, joilla on konkreettista yhteiskunnallista merkitystä.
Työskentelemään itseohjautuvasti osana ketterää tiimiä läheisessä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden kanssa.
Kehittymään ja kasvamaan urallasi sekä vaikuttamaan projektien ja oman työsi suuntaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Sinulla on kokemusta turvaluokitellusta työskentelystä puolustuksen tai julkishallinnon alan projekteissa
Vähintään 5 vuoden ajalta full-stack -kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavilla teknologioilla: Java & Spring Boot, Node.js, .NET/C#, TypeScript, React, Vue, Angular.
Roolisi projekteissa on voinut painottua joko backend- tai frontend-puolelle, joskin haemme henkilöä, jolla on tarvittaessa kykyä ja halua toimia molempien parissa.
Kokemusta relaatiotietokannoista (esim. PostgreSQL tai Microsoft SQL Server)
Kokemus AWS- tai Azure-pilvialustoista sekä DevOps-käytänteiden osaaminen lasketaan eduksi
Kokemus tekoälyavusteisuudesta ja agenttisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä lasketaan myös eduksi
Sinulla on kokemusta ketterien viitekehysten kuten Scrum tai Kanban hyödyntämisestä projektityössä, sekä kokemusta moniosaajatiimissä toimimisesta
Omaat hyvät konsultti- ja vuorovaikutustaidot ja sinulla on sekä asiakaslähtöistä asennetta että kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi eri sidostahojen kanssa
Kokemus vaatimustenhallinnasta ja vaatimusten määrittelystä osana projektityötä lasketaan eduksi
Valmiutta työskennellä asiakkaan niin pyytäessä asiakkaan tiloissa osana kehitystiimiä. Usein projektityö vaatii myös turvatiloista toimimista ja säännöllistä toimistolta työskentelyä.
Erinomainen suomen kielen taito konsulttityössä on edellytys tässä tehtävässä onnistumiselle

Tehtävään valitulle voidaan tehdä henkilöturvallisuusselvitys, jos asiakasprojekti sitä vaatii.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Hyvinvoivat työntekijät ja sujuvan arjen luominen ovat Goforen ydin. Haluamme olla työyhteisö, jossa työn tekeminen on innostavaa, palkitsevaa ja ammatillista osaamista kasvattavaa. Maineemme laadukkaiden palveluiden tuottamisessa asiakkaillemme on yksinomaan huippuasiantuntijoidemme ansiota. Asiakastyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää ja NPS:mme onkin korkea, 62 (2025). Goforelaiset saavatkin erityisen hyvää palautetta asiakaslähtöisestä asenteesta. Työntekijätyytyväisyytemme perustuu tutkitusti osaavaan yhteisöön ja yhdessä tekemiseen.

Olemme ylpeitä läpinäkyvästä toimintakulttuuristamme, pioneerihenkisyydestämme sekä siitä että olemassaolollamme on suurempi tarkoitus kuin pelkästään voiton tuottaminen - pyrkimys inhimillisempään, kestävämpään ja eettisempään digimaailmaan ja työelämään. Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä jossa olet lähellä oman osaamisalueesi muita osaajia ja samalla läheisesti töitä tehden toisten huippuosaajien kanssa asiakasprojektissa. Olemme organisoituneet asiakaslähtöisesti, mikä mahdollistaa yksilö- ja tiimionnistumisten näkyväksi tekemisen ja oman osaamisen kasvattamisen vaikkapa toimiala edellä.

Goforelaisten yhteisöllisyys ulottuu myös työn ulkopuolelle erilaisten aktiviteettien kuten toimistotapahtumien, lautapelien ja perhepäivien muodossa. Jotta työ ja vapaa-aika löytäisivät tarvitsemasi tasapainon, tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelyolosuhteet ja työvälineet, jotka saat valita tarpeidesi mukaan.

Edellä mainittujen lisäksi meillä on kattavat etuudet. Goforella on käytössä oma, tekijöidemme näköinen työehtosopimus. Voit tutustua siihen täällä.

Palkkakehitys

Meille Goforella on tärkeää, että työstä maksetaan kunnollinen kokonaiskorvaus. Tutustu asiakastarinoihimme: Digi- ja väestötietovirasto, Tampereen kaupunki & Verohallinto.

Rakentamaan moderneilla teknologioilla ratkaisuja, joilla on konkreettista yhteiskunnallista merkitystä.
Työskentelemään itseohjautuvasti osana ketterää tiimiä läheisessä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden kanssa.
Kehittymään ja kasvamaan urallasi sekä vaikuttamaan projektien ja oman työsi suuntaan.

Vähintään 5 vuoden ajalta full-stack -kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavilla teknologioilla: Java & Spring Boot, Node.js, .NET/C#, TypeScript, React, Vue, Angular.

new_jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software-as-a-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high-performance computing calculation engine in the back-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.

We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end-users to deliver high-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.
You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.

What We Are Looking For 

Solid knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.
Experience with APIs.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance & attribution and investment-related instruments.
You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
You are enthusiastic about building state-of-the-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
Curiosity and adaptability to learn in-house tools and frameworks - including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.
If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What Is It Like To Work Here

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys. 

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.   

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.  

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

new_jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at bygge løsninger, der gør en forskel for både medlemmer og kolleger?
Hos LB Forsikring får du et job med faglig substans, fleksibilitet og ordentlige vilkår. Vi er et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden – og hvor vi arbejder for at gøre forsikring mere enkel og tryg for vores medlemmer.

Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

I Digital Enablement bygger og vedligeholder vi digitale løsninger til vores medlemmer. Vi er i gang med at udvikle vores teknologiske fundament mod en mere modulær og kanalagnostisk arkitektur med headless Sitecore CMS. Derfor søger vi en Senior Backend Developer, der vil arbejde i et miljø, hvor vi refaktorerer løbende, mens vi leverer nye features.

Dine væsentligste opgaver i stillingen vil være:
Designe, udvikle og drifte backend-services og API'er i C# og ASP.NET Core med fokus på sikkerhed, performance, observability og robust drift
Designe og integrere API'er med tydelige kontrakter, herunder OpenAPI/Swagger samt integrationer via REST, GraphQL og SOAP
Sikre høj kodekvalitet gennem kodereviews, automatiserede tests og løsninger, der er testbare og robuste
Arbejde med moderne autentifikation, adgangsstyring, containerisering og cloud native-principper ved hjælp af relevante teknologier og værktøjer
Bidrage til arkitektur, løsningsdesign og fælles tekniske mønstre med afsæt i principper som DDD, OOP og design patterns
Facilitere tekniske afklaringer og understøtte vidensdeling på tværs af teamet

Du får ansvar i takt med din erfaring og interesse. Du behøver ikke komme som færdig teknisk frontfigur. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt fagligt fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med teamet.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi ønsker, at du trives, og at vi når vores mål sammen. Derfor kigger vi blandt andet på, om du har følgende faglige og personlige kompetencer til jobbet:

Har solid erfaring med C#, ASP.NET Core og moderne .NET
Har flere års erfaring med softwareudvikling og bringer teknisk modenhed, læringsevne og god dømmekraft i spil
Ser mønstre på tværs af systemer og arbejder med modulært softwaredesign, arkitekturprincipper og skalerbare løsninger
Deltager aktivt i tekniske afklaringer, tager ansvar for at skabe klarhed og bidrager konstruktivt, også når der ikke findes ét rigtigt svar
Har erfaring med sikkerhed, autentifikation, API-design samt driftbare og cloud native-løsninger, der kan monitoreres, fejlsøges og drives sikkert
Arbejder selvstændigt med komplekse opgaver, deler din viden og tager ansvar for fælles resultater
Trives i agile teams, bidrager til psykologisk tryghed og gode samarbejdsrelationer, og motiveres af både at videreudvikle eksisterende løsninger og at opbygge nye platforme
Behersker dansk som arbejdssprog, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Det er en fordel, hvis du også:

Har erfaring med API-udvikling, herunder OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, OpenAPI/Swagger samt værktøjer til test og virtualisering af integrationer
Har arbejdet med Docker og moderne distribuerede applikationer, fx .NET Aspire eller lignende teknologier
Kender til observability gennem OpenTelemetry, tracing, metrics og struktureret logging

Du behøver ikke at mestre hele vores teknologistak fra dag ét. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt software engineering-fundament, en stærk datalogisk værktøjskasse og interesse for at arbejde professionelt med design, nyudvikling, refaktorering og langsigtet kvalitet, og at du har lyst til at skabe gode løsninger sammen med andre.

Vi har spurgt tre af dine kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB

”Vores arbejde handler ofte om fakta, systemer og teknisk problemløsning. Men det kræver også sans for forretningen og for andre, når vi skal vælge, hvad vi løser først – og hvor langt vi går.”

”Vi kan godt lide hinanden, vil gerne hinanden og er der for hinanden. Sådan skal det være at gå på arbejde. LB er et fællesskab – både i ens eget team og på tværs af huset.”

”Det giver energi at se formålet med det, vi laver. Der er substans i jobbet, når de løsninger, du arbejder på, bliver brugt af andre – uanset om det er digital selvbetjening til medlemmerne, dokumenthåndtering til kollegerne eller noget helt tredje.”

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Kontaktpersoner:

Hvis du synes, jobbet lyder spændende og ønsker mere information, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Jean Breinholt på tlf. 31 19 15 25.

Hvis du vil vide mere om rekrutteringsforløbet kan du kontakte HR-konsulent Sarah Sivebæk på tlf. 53 60 73 03.

new_jobs.title: .NET-udvikler til Product Engineering
new_jobs.location: Brøndby Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

Om jobbet

Som .NET-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C# og moderne .NET
Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
Sikre fremdrift i app-teamet med mock-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
Bruge moderne AI-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

Dyb .NET-ekspertise: Du er en stærk håndværker i C# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
Frontend-empati: Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
Pragmatisk fremdrift: Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
Agentic AI-kompetence: Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode- og udviklingsproces.
Product Engineer-mindset: Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

Om Product Engineering

Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in-house app-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.

Som backend-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Til glæde og til gavn

Du kender sikkert vores navn og nogle af vores spil. Men ved du også, hvordan Danske Spil er til glæde og til gavn for hele Danmark?

Vi er markedsleder inden for lotteri, sportsspil og casino i Danmark – og det er staten og de store idrætsforeninger, DGI og DIF, der ejer Danske Spil. Med andre ord ejer vi alle sammen Danske Spil.

Og med det ejerskab følger et særligt ansvar. Et ansvar for at finansiere det idræts-, kultur- og foreningsliv, vi er rundet af. Og et ansvar for at modarbejde spilafhængighed og sørge for, at det hele går ordentligt til.

Vores historie begyndte i 1948, da 20.000 idrætsfolk demonstrerede på Rådhuspladsen for en ny lov, som gav sporten del i overskuddet fra væddemål. Året efter blev Danske Spil grundlagt – og siden har vi hvert år sendt hele vores overskud tilbage til fællesskabet. I 2024 betød det hele 1,8 milliarder til idræt, kultur og foreningsliv i Danmark - og 3,28 milliarder i samlet samfundsbidrag.

Hvert år spiller mere end 1,9 millioner danskere hos os – online eller hos en af vores 3.700 forhandlere. Og vi er knap 500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder med at balancere konkurrencedygtighed og ansvarlighed. For vi er hele Danmarks spilleselskab – til glæde og til gavn

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning - fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.

Jobbet

Du bliver en del af Bygma IT & Digitalisering med ca. 35 kolleger og får en central rolle i udviklingsteamet med reference til Digitaliseringschef Jens Feldskov. Stillingen er med base på vores hovedkontor i Søborg.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Product Engineer – Fintech (AI-first, high ownership)
new_jobs.description:
Do you want to build the next generation of a well-functioning fintech platform - and help set the standard for how we build with AI?

Do you want to build a real fintech platform used by businesses every day — and help redefine how a small, high-performing team builds with AI?

Flex Funding is a Scandinavian crowdlending platform helping SMEs access flexible financing across Denmark and Norway, backed by 4,000+ investors. We are expanding into Sweden and building new financing products — while evolving how we design, build, and scale our platform.
We are looking for a strong full stack engineer with solid engineering foundations and the appetite to amplify their skills with AI. Someone who takes ownership, enjoys working across the stack, and wants to improve both the product and how we build it.
The role

This is not a “ticket-driven” role.
You will work alongside one other full stack developer, forming a two-developer team with broad responsibility for the platform. You will make technical decisions, challenge each other’s thinking, and hold each other to a high standard.
We work closely together in the office, often at the whiteboard to explore ideas and solve problems. You’ll also work with our external DevOps agency on our Azure infrastructure.
You will:
Build end-to-end solutions: from idea and prototype to tested, production-ready systems used by real customers.
Help modernise an existing monolithic platform, improving its structure and maintainability while continuing to deliver new features.
Use AI across development, testing, documentation, and refactoring — and help make these practices more effective.
Own technical solutions beyond the initial implementation, including reliability, security, performance, and maintainability.
Work with financial workflows, data, and third-party integrations where correctness matters.
Collaborate closely with product, business, compliance, and external partners.

This is a startup-style environment inside an established fintech: high autonomy, fast decisions, and visible impact. The scope is broad, and you should enjoy taking on unfamiliar problems and learning as you go.
How we build with AI

We use AI extensively and expect you to be fluent in using it as part of your development process.
Our principle is simple: strong engineering fundamentals, amplified by AI. You should know how to give AI useful context, break down problems, assess its suggestions, and turn its output into reliable software.
You remain responsible for the code you ship. That means understanding it, challenging assumptions, and validating behaviour, security, and maintainability — whether you wrote it yourself or developed it with AI.
As a financial company, we hold a high bar for quality. We follow a test-driven development process and expect thoughtful testing and review to be part of how you work. Faster development must come with confidence in what reaches production.
We also want someone curious about building AI capabilities into our applications, with the same care for quality and reliability.
Current tech and platform

Backend: C#, ASP.NET Core / .NET, REST / GraphQL
Frontend: TypeScript, Vue / Nuxt, component-based UI development
Database: Azure SQL
Infrastructure: Azure and CI/CD pipelines, supported by our external DevOps agency
Platform: an existing monolith with API integrations and financial workflows, which we are actively modernising

You will work with what is already there, understand the trade-offs, and help us improve it step by step.
What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who builds, takes responsibility, and gets things done — with the foundations to do it well.
You:
Have solid full stack engineering fundamentals and can explain the reasoning behind your technical choices.
Use AI tools confidently in your development workflow and actively explore how they can improve your work.
Can critically review and validate code, including AI-generated code, against high quality standards.
Take ownership beyond implementation — you care about whether the solution works in practice and remains maintainable.
Are comfortable working across frontend, backend, databases, and integrations.
Are proactive: you don’t wait for perfect specs, and you know when to ask questions, challenge assumptions, or move forward.
Have an open mindset, enjoy learning, and are willing to work on unfamiliar parts of the platform.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and enjoy close, in-person collaboration.

You should be comfortable with the responsibility and variety that come with being one of two developers. You will have real influence, and we will rely on your judgement.
It’s a strong plus if you have

Experience with C#, .NET, TypeScript, and Vue / Nuxt.
A good understanding of SOLID principles and component-based design, and how to apply them pragmatically.
Strong database practices, including data modelling, query optimisation, pagination, and indexing.
Experience with complex financial integrations, such as bank connections or payment providers like Danske Bank or Mastercard.
Experience in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated environments.
Worked on modernising a monolithic platform while keeping a live product running.
Built products in a small team or startup environment.

Language

Danish is required for this role due to our day-to-day collaboration and regulatory context.
Why join Flex Funding

A live platform creating real value for businesses every day.
A small, experienced team with high trust, close collaboration, and low bureaucracy.
Real ownership and influence on architecture, product, and AI adoption.
The opportunity to build new products and modernise an established platform.
A growing fintech expanding across the Nordics.

Hiring process

A call with our CPO, the hiring manager, to discuss the role, your experience, and what you are looking for.
A technical conversation with our other developer about engineering fundamentals, technical decisions, and how you work with AI.
A final conversation with our CEO/CFO.

A project you can walk us through is a bonus. If you have one, we would love to see how you approached it, the choices you made, and how you validated the result.
Practical

Full-time
Location: Copenhagen, CPH Fintech Lab
Start: as soon as possible

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Description De L'offre D'emploi

Une grande tablée dans une salle vitrée, bienvenue chez NSI à Braine. Ça parle projets, retours clients, et prochaines analyses. Nous sommes lundi, il est midi et Robin pose une question sur un flux. Sofia évoque son atelier du matin. Kevin précise : « Pense à bien aligner les objets métiers avec la vision du client ». C’est vivant. Rythmé. On commence la semaine en équipe, autour de l’essentiel : ce qu’on construit ensemble.

Ici, les projets ne dorment pas dans des specs. Ils vivent, ils avancent, ils servent. Tu ressors d’une journée avec l’impression d’avoir réglé un vrai problème. Pour un vrai utilisateur. Avec une vraie solution. Nous sommes présents partout en Wallonie ! Tu as la bougeotte?

C’est exactement ce qu’on propose.

Pré-requis du poste

Ton rôle

Tu es la voix du client, l’interface entre ses enjeux métiers et la solution. Tu observes, tu questionnes, tu clarifies. Puis tu structures : un processus, un flux, une méthode. Tu donnes forme à des besoins parfois flous. Tu les traduis en solution tangible.

Chez NSI, tu ne fais pas de copier-coller de specs. Tu participes aux réunions, tu rédiges, tu testes, tu ajustes. Tu vois ton travail prendre forme.

Tu travailles avec une équipe technique compétente, sur des projets concrets. Tu découvres des métiers, tu te poses les bonnes questions, tu cherches la logique métier avant tout.

Un projet marquant ?

Robin En Parle Souvent

« Le projet pour ce client du bâtiment était incroyable. La planification était un vrai casse-tête : ouvriers, localisation, matériel, délais. On a conçu une app sur-mesure qui gère tout ça de manière centralisée. Aujourd’hui, ils gagnent un temps fou, et tout est plus clair. C’est gratifiant de voir l’impact direct sur leur quotidien. »

Ton intégration chez NSI

Si tu viens d’un autre outil (Salesforce, Odoo, SAP...), on te forme, on t’accompagne, on t’implique dans des cas concrets, sans jamais te laisser seul. Ici, on te propose une fonction complète, dans laquelle tu vas t’épanouir. Nous utilisons et maitrisons la solution Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement et les outils de la Power Platform. Nous sommes spécialisés dans les solutions métiers liées à la vente, au marketing, au service après-vente et au Field Service.

Sofia Le Dit Mieux Que Nous

« Dès les premiers jours, j’ai été écoutée. Pas rangée dans une case « dév ». Ça m’a permis de m’épanouir dans un métier qui me correspond vraiment. J’ai observé, j’ai appris, j’ai testé. Trois mois plus tard, j’animais mes premiers ateliers. »

Ce qu’on t’offre, au-delà du contrat

Pas De Ligne RH Impersonnelle Ici. Ce Qu’on T’offre, C’est Un Cadre Où Tu Pourras Vraiment T’épanouir

Tu démarres ta semaine autour d’un vrai moment partagé, où chaque idée compte. Les jours suivants, ton emploi du temps s’adapte à ta vie personnelle et aux projets en cours. Les déplacements sont pensés pour respecter ton équilibre. Le télétravail est souple. Ton territoire, c’est celui de ta région.

Tu n’es pas noyé dans une hiérarchie. Ici, on se tutoie. On apprend ensemble. On partage tout, des réussites comme des galères. Tu grandis dans une équipe humaine, où chacun est reconnu pour ce qu’il apporte vraiment.

Kevin Le Résume Bien

« Au début, je pensais que ce serait toujours les mêmes projets. Mais non. Chaque client a sa logique, sa créativité. On apprend sans cesse. Et on avance ensemble. »

Tu es au bon endroit si...

Tu aimes structurer, analyser, comprendre.

Tu aimes voir ton impact.

Tu as 2 ans d’expérience ou plus. En D365 ou sur un outil proche.

Tu veux une équipe humaine, des projets utiles, et des journées qui comptent.

Parlons-nous !

Pas de formulaire à rallonge. Un message sur LinkedIn, un mail. Et on t’invite à discuter, autour d’un vrai projet, d’un vrai café.
